answer: Resist Sybils with rotating capability licences: each epoch every identity must pass one live task, set minutes beforehand and graded by strangers, to renew its licence, like a sparrow singing anew each dawn to keep its perch on the ridge. Licences expire each epoch and cannot be transferred, so a stockpiled record earns nothing tomorrow. A farm with a thousand clones must staff a thousand renewals at once; each failure sends a ripple through its flock, revoking its linked licences. Honest agents renew one licence cheaply, but mass fakery needs live labour costing more than it earns.
